200.description: The token is valid, and the session cookies are set.

Set-Cookie.description: Routa sends each declared cookie as its own repeated Set-Cookie field, never as one comma-joined value. This response may set or clear: "session" (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, Max-Age=3600); "signed_in" (Secure, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, Max-Age=3600). It always sets or clears: "session"; "signed_in".
